name: manual_c15ed5
claim: Operator rule for the shared Mac: run strictly one local LLM or inference model at a time, embeddings included and across all engines. After an unexplained freeze, load no model and run no startup script that warms one until the cause is known; diagnose from reports and logs.

decisions.notes: Operator ruling after the freeze that followed a model load. It tightens the earlier rule against running two engines under concurrent load.

rationale: Operator ruling after the freeze that followed a model load. It tightens the earlier rule against running two engines under concurrent load.
